ruleset_status: Courtship of Flower Demons — Book of Secrets cross-references (TCOTFD). Combat entries inferred from encounter table inline rules where BoS text is not reproduced.

1.name: Flower Portal
1.summary: Return from Seaside to the Forsaken Depths (TCOTFD).

3.name: Break Silver Lock
3.summary: ACERBIC keyword — break the Queen's Locked Vault silver chain (TCOTFD).

8.name: Matron Head Quest
8.summary: Matron of Summer is pleased — quest to bring the Lady of Lament's head; reward Epic Rewards or Blossoms Magic Item (TCOTFD p.51).

9.name: Lady of Lament TRUELOVE
9.summary: The wooing character alone marks TRUELOVE; satyrs cannot be her one true love (TCOTFD p.52).

11.name: TRUELOVE and PANDORA Harvest
11.summary: Special harvest bounty when both keywords are marked (TCOTFD).

12.name: Queen's Locked Vault
12.summary: TRUELOVE opens the vault; gain d6×10 gp in gems and 1 magic item (TCOTFD).

13.name: Secret Trail
13.summary: Spend 1 Clue on a Woods pathway for a secret trail — net +1 Clue (TCOTFD).

14.name: Hidden Pathway
14.summary: Cleric of Tamas Zeya, paladin, cambion, or succubus finds a hidden Riverside shortcut (TCOTFD).

15.name: Keepsake Frost Roses
15.summary: KEEPSAKE at Frost Roses — heal d6 Life and remove 1 Melancholy (TCOTFD).

18.name: Mirror Demon Reflection
18.summary: First hit by Mirror Demon — d6: 1-3 lose random inventory item, 4-6 gain d3 Clues (TCOTFD).

20.name: Blue-Haired Queen Combat
20.summary: Mesmerizing save or −1 Attack for the encounter; queen fights with her maids (TCOTFD).

22.name: Disturbing Altar
22.summary: Examine Xichtul altar — gain 1 Madness or d3 Clues (player choice, TCOTFD).

23.name: Matron of Summer Combat
23.summary: Matron lashes all front-rank heroes each round; if slain she returns furious (+6 reactions) once (TCOTFD).

24.name: Maypole Dancers Combat
24.summary: Mesmerize save or party cannot flee this encounter (TCOTFD).

26.name: Giggling Gingers Combat
26.summary: Mesmerize save or −1 Attack; dominant stance blocked (TCOTFD).

28.name: Colleen of Lilies Combat
28.summary: Mesmerize save each round or skip next attack (TCOTFD).

30.name: Matron Wooing
30.summary: Unearthly pleasures — +1 Life and +1 Madness (2 for elves), permanent on first visit; passionate stance −1 to her level (TCOTFD p.61).

31.name: Ominous Omen
31.summary: First visit — mark omen and gain 1 Melancholy; repeat grants d3 Clues (TCOTFD).

32.name: Lex the Cambion Shop
32.summary: Pay 300gp + oath or trade a soul cube; pick any three items from Blossoms magic, Blossoms scrolls, or 4AD magic treasure tables (TCOTFD p.61, p.69).

33.name: Maze of Wondrous Awe
33.summary: Lost in the maze — spend 1 Clue to escape or wander (gain 1 Melancholy, TCOTFD).
